title: Newspaper Headlines & Reporting
sub: Words and phrases used in news reports, editorials and headlines.

cards.def:
the first page of a newspaper, carrying the biggest stories
हिंदी: पहला पन्ना / मुखपृष्ठ
examples: The scandal made the front page of every paper.
Her photo was on the front page today.
My father reads the front page first every morning.
The cricket win was all over the front page.

cards.def:
the line naming the writer of an article
हिंदी: लेखक का नाम (लेख के ऊपर)
examples: The byline showed it was written by a senior editor.
She finally got her first byline.
Check the byline to see who wrote the article.
The story ran without a byline.

cards.def:
the line giving the place and date of a report
हिंदी: समाचार का स्थान और तिथि वाली पंक्ति
examples: The dateline said "New Delhi, Monday".
A dateline tells you where the reporter filed the story.
The dateline showed the story was filed from Mumbai.
The article's dateline was two days old.

cards.def:
news that is just happening and being reported
हिंदी: ताज़ा / तुरंत की ख़बर
examples: Breaking news — the bridge has collapsed.
We interrupt this programme for breaking news.
We saw the breaking news on our phones at lunch.
Breaking news: the airport is closed due to fog.

cards.def:
a story published first by one outlet only
हिंदी: विशेष / केवल हमारे पास की ख़बर
examples: The channel aired an exclusive interview.
It was an exclusive report on the deal.
The magazine got an exclusive with the cricket captain.
Readers paid extra for the exclusive story.

cards.def:
an important story obtained before rivals
हिंदी: सबसे पहले मिली बड़ी ख़बर
examples: The reporter landed a major scoop.
They beat everyone to the scoop.
The local paper got the scoop on the new metro line.
Her scoop about the scam won an award.

cards.def:
the most important story in a bulletin or paper
हिंदी: मुख्य ख़बर
examples: Floods are today's lead story.
The lead story covers the budget.
The election result was the lead story on every channel.
Today's lead story is about rising fuel prices.

cards.def:
a regular article by a particular writer
हिंदी: स्तंभ
examples: He writes a weekly column on politics.
I never miss her Sunday column.
She reads the health column every Tuesday.
His column on money tips is very popular.

cards.def:
a person who writes a regular column
हिंदी: स्तंभकार
examples: The columnist criticised the policy.
She is a well-known sports columnist.
The columnist writes about life in small towns.
A famous columnist praised the new film.

cards.def:
a journalist who reports from a particular place or field
हिंदी: संवाददाता
examples: Our Paris correspondent filed the report.
He is the paper's political correspondent.
The war correspondent reported from the front line.
Our business correspondent explains the budget.

cards.def:
a person who gathers and reports news
हिंदी: रिपोर्टर / पत्रकार
examples: The reporter interviewed the minister.
A young reporter broke the story.
A reporter called me for a comment on the strike.
The reporter waited outside the court all day.

cards.def:
the person with final authority over a publication
हिंदी: प्रधान संपादक
examples: The editor-in-chief approved the front page.
She was promoted to editor-in-chief.
The editor-in-chief apologised for the mistake.
Every big story needs the editor-in-chief's approval.

cards.def:
an official statement given to the media
हिंदी: प्रेस विज्ञप्ति
examples: The company issued a press release on Friday.
The press release denied the rumours.
The press release announced the new CEO.
We sent a press release about our product launch.

cards.def:
a meeting where officials answer reporters' questions
हिंदी: प्रेस वार्ता
examples: The minister called a press conference.
Questions were taken at the end of the press conference.
The coach spoke at a press conference after the match.
The police held a press conference about the arrest.

cards.def:
a short official update given to journalists
हिंदी: प्रेस ब्रीफ़िंग
examples: The spokesperson held a daily press briefing.
Details emerged in a press briefing.
The health ministry gives a press briefing every evening.
At the press briefing, officials shared new numbers.

cards.def:
said privately, not to be published
हिंदी: अनौपचारिक रूप से (प्रकाशित न करने की शर्त पर)
examples: He told me off the record that he would resign.
Nothing said off the record can be printed.
The official spoke off the record about the delays.
Remember, this conversation is off the record.

cards.def:
said openly and allowed to be published
हिंदी: औपचारिक रूप से (प्रकाशन हेतु)
examples: She went on the record to deny the claim.
He is willing to speak on the record.
The CEO refused to comment on the record.
Can I quote you on the record?

cards.def:
a person or document that provides information
हिंदी: सूत्र
examples: A reliable source confirmed the report.
The paper protected its source.
Journalists must check every source carefully.
The minister's office was the source of the leak.

cards.def:
an informant whose name is withheld
हिंदी: अज्ञात सूत्र
examples: An anonymous source leaked the memo.
The story relies on anonymous sources.
According to an anonymous source, the company will be sold.
The report quoted an anonymous source inside the police.

cards.def:
a person who saw an event happen
हिंदी: चश्मदीद गवाह
examples: An eyewitness described the accident.
Eyewitness accounts differ.
The police are looking for an eyewitness to the theft.
An eyewitness took a video of the fire.

cards.def:
claimed but not yet proven
हिंदी: कथित
examples: The alleged fraud is under investigation.
He is the alleged mastermind.
The alleged thief was arrested at the station.
The company denied the alleged tax fraud.

cards.def:
a phrase used when information comes from unnamed people
हिंदी: सूत्रों के अनुसार
examples: Sources say the deal is close.
Sources say an announcement is due.
Sources say the star will join the new film.
Sources say petrol prices may rise next week.

cards.def:
to publicly withdraw a statement or story
हिंदी: वापस लेना / खंडन करना
examples: The paper had to retract the story.
He retracted his earlier claim.
The website retracted the article after complaints.
The politician refused to retract his comments.

cards.def:
a published fix to a mistake
हिंदी: सुधार / भूल-सुधार
examples: The paper printed a correction on page two.
We regret the error and issue this correction.
The magazine published a correction about the wrong date.
A small correction appeared in the next day's paper.

cards.def:
a reply that argues against a claim
हिंदी: खंडन / प्रत्युत्तर
examples: The ministry issued a sharp rebuttal.
Her rebuttal appeared the next day.
The company published a rebuttal to the report.
His rebuttal was clear and backed by data.

cards.def:
to prove a claim wrong
हिंदी: खंडन करना
examples: Officials refuted the allegations.
He tried to refute the report.
The scientist refuted the claim with new research.
The data refutes the idea that sales are falling.

cards.def:
not yet verified as true
हिंदी: अपुष्ट
examples: Unconfirmed reports speak of casualties.
The news remains unconfirmed.
Unconfirmed reports say the CEO has resigned.
Don't share unconfirmed news on WhatsApp.

cards.def:
a story still changing as events unfold
हिंदी: विकसित हो रही ख़बर
examples: This is a developing story.
We'll update this developing story.
The fire is a developing story, and details may change.
Reporters are following the developing story at the airport.

cards.def:
a later report adding to an earlier one
हिंदी: अनुवर्ती रिपोर्ट
examples: The paper ran a follow-up on the case.
A follow-up story revealed new details.
The follow-up showed that the bridge was repaired.
Readers wanted a follow-up on the missing girl.

cards.def:
thorough and detailed
हिंदी: गहन / विस्तृत
examples: The paper published an in-depth analysis.
She wrote an in-depth report on schools.
The documentary gives an in-depth look at village life.
We need an in-depth review of the accident.

cards.def:
a detailed examination and explanation of events
हिंदी: विश्लेषण
examples: The analysis explains why prices rose.
Read our analysis of the election.
The expert's analysis of the match was very sharp.
His analysis showed why the policy failed.

cards.def:
a long article about a topic or person
हिंदी: विशेष आलेख
examples: The magazine ran a feature on farmers.
I enjoyed the feature on city life.
The Sunday paper has a feature on street food.
She wrote a feature about women farmers.

cards.def:
a reader's letter published in a paper
हिंदी: संपादक के नाम पत्र
examples: He wrote a letter to the editor on potholes.
The letters to the editor page is popular.
My grandfather often writes a letter to the editor.
A letter to the editor complained about stray dogs.

cards.def:
a notice announcing a death with a short biography
हिंदी: श्रद्धांजलि-आलेख / मृत्यु-समाचार
examples: The obituary praised her life's work.
I read his obituary in the paper.
The obituary described his long career as a teacher.
Newspapers print obituaries of famous people.

cards.def:
small paid notices in categories like jobs or property
हिंदी: वर्गीकृत विज्ञापन
examples: He found a flat through classified ads.
The classified ads are on the last page.
They sold their old car through classified ads.
Job seekers used to check the classified ads every Sunday.

cards.def:
an extra section issued with a newspaper
हिंदी: पूरक अंक
examples: The Sunday supplement has travel stories.
A business supplement came with the paper.
The education supplement lists all the colleges.
My mother collects the weekend food supplement.

cards.def:
the number of copies a publication sells
हिंदी: प्रसार संख्या
examples: The paper's circulation has fallen.
It has the highest circulation in the state.
Online news has hit print circulation.
The magazine's circulation doubled after the special issue.

cards.def:
a small-format paper with sensational stories
हिंदी: टैबलॉयड / चटपटी ख़बरों वाला अख़बार
examples: The tabloid splashed the scandal.
He doesn't trust tabloid headlines.
The tabloid printed rumours about the actor.
Tabloid stories are often exaggerated.

cards.def:
a large-format serious newspaper
हिंदी: बड़े आकार का गंभीर अख़बार
examples: The broadsheet covered the budget in depth.
She prefers broadsheets to tabloids.
My father prefers a broadsheet for serious news.
The broadsheet published a long report on the economy.

cards.def:
a newspaper published every day
हिंदी: दैनिक अख़बार
examples: It is a leading national daily.
The daily reported the verdict.
The local daily covers news from our district.
She works as a reporter for an English daily.

cards.def:
a publication issued once a week
हिंदी: साप्ताहिक पत्रिका
examples: The weekly carried a long interview.
It's a respected business weekly.
He subscribes to a weekly on science and technology.
The weekly comes out every Friday.

cards.def:
a version of a publication issued at a time or place
हिंदी: संस्करण
examples: The city edition carries local news.
Buy the morning edition.
The Sunday edition has a crossword.
The online edition is updated all day.

cards.def:
submitted a story to the newsroom
हिंदी: रिपोर्ट भेजी
examples: The correspondent filed a report from the border.
She filed a report before midnight.
She filed a report from the flood-hit village.
The journalist filed a report just before the deadline.

cards.def:
the office where news is prepared
हिंदी: समाचार कक्ष
examples: The newsroom was buzzing after the verdict.
He works in a busy newsroom.
The newsroom was quiet before the results came in.
Young journalists learn fast in a newsroom.

cards.def:
a stall that sells papers and magazines
हिंदी: अख़बार की दुकान / स्टॉल
examples: He bought the paper at the newsstand.
The newsstand opens at dawn.
The newsstand at the station sells magazines in five languages.
I picked up a copy at the newsstand.

cards.def:
a short broadcast summary of news
हिंदी: समाचार बुलेटिन
examples: The evening news bulletin led with the storm.
Tune in for the hourly news bulletin.
The radio news bulletin is at eight.
The cyclone warning was in every news bulletin.

cards.def:
the evening hours with the most viewers
हिंदी: प्राइम टाइम
examples: The debate aired at prime time.
Prime-time news draws large audiences.
Advertisers pay more for prime time slots.
The final episode aired at prime time.

cards.def:
reporting of an event as it happens
हिंदी: सीधा प्रसारण / लाइव कवरेज
examples: The channel gave live coverage of the rally.
We bring you live coverage from the scene.
The channel had live coverage of the Republic Day parade.
Live coverage of the rescue kept viewers glued.

cards.def:
an online page updated minute by minute
हिंदी: लाइव ब्लॉग
examples: Follow the match on our live blog.
The paper ran a live blog on election day.
I followed the budget speech on a live blog.
The live blog had updates every minute.

cards.def:
a scrolling line of headlines on screen
हिंदी: टिकर / स्क्रीन पर चलती पट्टी
examples: The ticker flashed the latest score.
Read the news ticker at the bottom.
The stock ticker showed the market falling.
I saw the news on the ticker at the bottom of the screen.

cards.def:
a short striking quote used in news
हिंदी: संक्षिप्त चुटीला बयान
examples: His soundbite was on every channel.
Politicians love a catchy soundbite.
The minister's soundbite went viral online.
Journalists look for a good soundbite from every speech.

cards.def:
a staged occasion arranged for photographers
हिंदी: फ़ोटो खिंचवाने का आयोजन
examples: The visit was just a photo op.
The leaders posed for a photo op.
The minister planted one tree for a photo op.
The visit to the slum was criticised as a photo op.

cards.def:
the text printed under a photograph
हिंदी: चित्र-परिचय
examples: The caption named everyone in the picture.
Read the caption beneath the photo.
The caption had the wrong name.
Write a short caption for each photo in the report.

cards.def:
a person who checks and corrects copy
हिंदी: उप-संपादक
examples: The sub-editor trimmed the article.
A sub-editor fixed the headline.
The sub-editor caught a spelling mistake in the headline.
She started her career as a sub-editor.

cards.def:
to start printing a publication
हिंदी: छपाई के लिए जाना
examples: The paper goes to press at midnight.
The story went to press late.
The magazine goes to press every Thursday.
News that comes after we go to press will be online.

cards.def:
to delay printing for a late big story
हिंदी: मुख्य पृष्ठ रोक लेना
examples: They held the front page for the result.
Editors held the front page for the speech.
The editor decided to hold the front page for the verdict.
They held the front page when the plane crash news came in.

cards.def:
important enough to be reported
हिंदी: ख़बर बनने लायक़
examples: The collapse was clearly newsworthy.
Is this really newsworthy?
A dog saving a child is newsworthy.
The editor didn't think the story was newsworthy.

cards.def:
a story about people's lives and feelings
हिंदी: मानवीय रुचि की कहानी
examples: The paper ran a human-interest piece.
Readers love human-interest stories.
The human interest story about the rickshaw driver touched readers.
TV channels love human interest stories at the end of the news.

cards.def:
the general welfare of people
हिंदी: जनहित
examples: The report was published in the public interest.
It is a matter of public interest.
The court allowed the report because of public interest.
Is this story truly in the public interest?

cards.def:
the amount and way something is reported
हिंदी: कवरेज / रिपोर्टिंग
examples: The coverage of the floods was extensive.
Media coverage of the trial was heavy.
The election got wide coverage in foreign media.
Some people felt the coverage was biased.

cards.def:
a company that publishes or broadcasts news
हिंदी: मीडिया संस्थान
examples: Several media outlets carried the story.
The media outlet apologised.
Foreign media outlets covered the festival.
The company sent its statement to every major media outlet.

cards.def:
an agency that supplies news to many outlets
हिंदी: समाचार एजेंसी
examples: The story came from a wire service.
The paper subscribes to a wire service.
Small newspapers rely on a wire service for world news.
The photo was supplied by a wire service.

cards.def:
to remove or ban material considered unacceptable
हिंदी: सेंसर करना
examples: The government tried to censor the report.
The film was heavily censored.
Some countries censor social media during protests.
The school censored the student magazine.

cards.def:
a legal order banning discussion of a case
हिंदी: गोपनीयता आदेश / बोलने पर रोक
examples: A judge issued a gag order.
The gag order barred the media.
Because of the gag order, the lawyers couldn't speak to reporters.
The court lifted the gag order after the verdict.

cards.def:
to reveal something dishonest or shocking
हिंदी: पर्दाफ़ाश करना
examples: The paper exposed the scam.
The series exposed corruption.
The documentary exposed poor conditions in the factory.
A journalist exposed the fake degree racket.

cards.def:
a court decision of major importance
हिंदी: ऐतिहासिक फ़ैसला
examples: The landmark ruling changed the law.
A landmark ruling upheld privacy.
The landmark ruling gave women equal rights to family property.
Lawyers celebrated the landmark ruling outside the court.

cards.def:
a person charged with a crime
हिंदी: आरोपी
examples: The accused pleaded not guilty.
Two accused were arrested.
The accused was released on bail.
The lawyer met the accused in jail.

cards.def:
a formal list of charges filed in court
हिंदी: आरोप-पत्र
examples: Police filed the charge sheet.
The charge sheet names five people.
The charge sheet runs to two thousand pages.
The police have ninety days to file a charge sheet.

cards.def:
a first report of a crime lodged with the police
हिंदी: प्राथमिकी (एफ़आईआर)
examples: An FIR was registered against him.
She went to file an FIR.
Police refused to register an FIR at first.
You can now file an FIR online for lost phones.

cards.def:
to officially order someone to appear
हिंदी: तलब करना / समन भेजना
examples: The court summoned the minister.
He was summoned for questioning.
The tax office summoned the businessman for questioning.
The witness was summoned to court next week.

cards.def:
a court order halting an action temporarily
हिंदी: स्थगन आदेश
examples: The High Court issued a stay order.
A stay order froze the construction.
The residents got a stay order against the demolition.
The stay order will last until the next hearing.

cards.def:
formally presented for discussion
हिंदी: सदन में रखा गया
examples: The bill was tabled in Parliament.
A motion was tabled yesterday.
The budget was tabled in the assembly this morning.
A new report was tabled before the committee.

cards.def:
approved officially
हिंदी: पारित किया
examples: Parliament passed the bill.
The proposal was passed.
The new data protection law was passed last year.
The resolution was passed by a large majority.

cards.def:
leaving a meeting in protest
हिंदी: बहिर्गमन
examples: Opposition MPs staged a walkout.
The walkout delayed the session.
Workers staged a walkout over unpaid wages.
The walkout ended after the chairman agreed to talks.

cards.def:
a change in ministers' posts
हिंदी: मंत्रिमंडल फेरबदल
examples: A cabinet reshuffle is expected soon.
The reshuffle brought in new faces.
The cabinet reshuffle gave the finance ministry a new face.
Rumours of a cabinet reshuffle filled the papers.

cards.def:
formally given an office by taking an oath
हिंदी: शपथ दिलाई गई
examples: He was sworn in as chief minister.
The new judge was sworn in.
The new mayor was sworn in on Monday.
The prime minister was sworn in at a grand ceremony.

cards.def:
a win by an overwhelming margin
हिंदी: भारी बहुमत से जीत
examples: The party won a landslide victory.
It was a landslide victory for her.
The young candidate won a landslide victory in her first election.
Polls did not predict such a landslide victory.

cards.def:
a result with no party holding a majority
हिंदी: त्रिशंकु संसद
examples: The election produced a hung parliament.
A hung house led to coalition talks.
After the hung parliament, small parties became very important.
Experts predict a hung parliament this time.

cards.def:
the period of travelling to win votes
हिंदी: चुनाव प्रचार का दौर
examples: Leaders hit the campaign trail.
He is back on the campaign trail.
The actor joined his party on the campaign trail.
On the campaign trail, leaders give several speeches a day.

cards.def:
a group reliably voting for one party
हिंदी: वोट बैंक
examples: The scheme targets a particular vote bank.
Parties court the vote bank.
Critics accuse parties of vote bank politics.
Free schemes are often aimed at a vote bank.

cards.def:
an election held to fill a single vacant seat
हिंदी: उपचुनाव
examples: The party won the by-election.
A by-election will be held in May.
The by-election was held after the MLA resigned.
Turnout was low in the by-election.

cards.def:
a prominent front-page story
हिंदी: मुख्य पृष्ठ की बड़ी ख़बर
examples: The scandal was the day's splash.
The paper splashed the news across page one.
The paper's splash was about the new airport.
The cricket final made the front-page splash.

cards.def:
a large headline across the top of the page
हिंदी: पूरे पन्ने पर फैली बड़ी सुर्ख़ी
examples: A banner headline announced the win.
The banner headline shocked readers.
A banner headline read: India Wins the World Cup.
The banner headline was in bright red letters.

cards.def:
a page traditionally for lighter or sensational content
हिंदी: तीसरा पन्ना (हल्की ख़बरों वाला)
examples: The story appeared on page three.
It didn't make page three.
Celebrity parties often appear on page three.
She became famous after a page three photo.

cards.def:
a single piece of news
हिंदी: समाचार का एक अंश
examples: It was a minor news item.
A news item caught my eye.
I read a news item about a new metro station.
The news item was only two lines long.

cards.def:
the pattern of how stories rise and fade
हिंदी: समाचार चक्र
examples: The story vanished from the news cycle.
A 24-hour news cycle never stops.
In today's news cycle, stories are forgotten in a day.
The minister tried to control the news cycle.

cards.def:
a brief urgent bulletin
हिंदी: न्यूज़ फ़्लैश / आपातकालीन समाचार
examples: A news flash interrupted the match.
The news flash confirmed the rumour.
A news flash announced the earthquake.
We got a news flash about the election result.

cards.def:
the main stories of a bulletin
हिंदी: मुख्य समाचार
examples: Floods are headline news today.
It made the headline news.
The price rise is headline news across the country.
Her success made headline news in her hometown.

cards.def:
just printed or newly published
हिंदी: ताज़ा-ताज़ा छपा
examples: Here is the story, hot off the press.
The report is hot off the press.
The new magazine issue is hot off the press.
I got the exam results hot off the press.

cards.def:
to become a major news story
हिंदी: सुर्ख़ियों में आना
examples: The case made headlines worldwide.
Her speech made headlines.
The young scientist made headlines with her discovery.
The startup made headlines after raising money.

cards.def:
to suddenly become big news
हिंदी: अचानक सुर्ख़ियों में छा जाना
examples: The scandal hit the headlines.
He hit the headlines last week.
The small village hit the headlines after the rescue.
The company hit the headlines for the wrong reasons.

cards.def:
to attract media attention
हिंदी: सुर्ख़ियाँ बटोरना
examples: The protest grabbed headlines.
His remark grabbed headlines.
The celebrity wedding grabbed headlines all week.
Big promises often grab headlines before elections.

cards.def:
very important news
हिंदी: पहले पन्ने की ख़बर
examples: The result was front-page news.
It's front-page news today.
The bridge collapse was front-page news.
Her gold medal was front-page news across India.

cards.def:
a newsseller's call to buy the news
हिंदी: पूरी ख़बर पढ़िए
examples: Extra, extra, read all about it!
Read all about it inside.
The boy at the station shouted, read all about it!
Read all about it in tomorrow's edition.

cards.def:
to meet and shake hands with the public
हिंदी: जनता से हाथ मिलाना / मिलना-जुलना
examples: Leaders press the flesh before elections.
He pressed the flesh at the market.
The candidate pressed the flesh at the vegetable market.
Ministers like to press the flesh at public events.

cards.def:
to present facts in a favourable way
हिंदी: ख़बर को अपने ढंग से पेश करना
examples: The party tried to spin the story.
Officials spun the story well.
The company tried to spin a story about record profits.
Don't spin a story; just tell us what happened.

cards.def:
an important report placed where few will see it
हिंदी: दबा दी गई ख़बर
examples: The story was buried on page twelve.
They buried the bad news.
The buried story about the scam got little attention.
Readers rarely notice a buried story.

cards.def:
a total ban on reporting something
हिंदी: ख़बरों पर पूरी रोक
examples: The government imposed a news blackout.
A news blackout hid the facts.
A news blackout was imposed during the operation.
The news blackout made people more worried.

cards.def:
public judgement of a case by the press
हिंदी: मीडिया द्वारा सुनवाई
examples: Many fear a media trial.
The court warned against a media trial.
The actor said he was a victim of a media trial.
A media trial can harm an innocent person.

cards.def:
intense and excited press attention
हिंदी: मीडिया में हड़कंप
examples: The arrest caused a media frenzy.
Reporters created a frenzy outside.
The celebrity's arrival caused a media frenzy at the airport.
The media frenzy made it hard for the family to grieve.

cards.def:
the seats for reporters in a legislature
हिंदी: प्रेस दीर्घा
examples: He watched from the press gallery.
Reporters filled the press gallery.
The press gallery was full during the budget speech.
Reporters in the press gallery took notes quickly.

cards.def:
a card allowing a journalist entry
हिंदी: प्रेस पास
examples: She showed her press pass at the gate.
Journalists need a press pass.
You need a press pass to enter the stadium media area.
His press pass was checked twice.

cards.def:
materials given to journalists at an event
हिंदी: प्रेस किट
examples: Each reporter received a press pack.
Details are in the press pack.
The press pack included photos and product details.
Read the press pack before the launch event.

cards.def:
a service delivering stories to outlets
हिंदी: समाचार तार सेवा
examples: The story moved on the newswire.
The newswire reported the quake.
Newswire reports said the talks had failed.
The news came first on the newswire.

cards.def:
a freelance reporter paid per story
हिंदी: स्वतंत्र संवाददाता / स्ट्रिंगर
examples: A local stringer filed the report.
He works as a stringer.
The paper relies on a stringer in the hill district.
As a stringer, he gets paid for each story.

cards.def:
a self-employed writer or journalist
हिंदी: स्वतंत्र पत्रकार
examples: She is a freelance journalist.
The paper hires freelancers.
As a freelancer, she writes for three magazines.
Many freelancers work from home.

cards.def:
the author's name above an article
हिंदी: लेखक का नाम
examples: He earned a by-line at last.
The by-line was missing.
Her by-line appeared on the front page.
A by-line tells readers who wrote the story.

cards.def:
text written for publication
हिंदी: प्रकाशन हेतु लिखी सामग्री
examples: The reporter filed her copy.
The editor checked the copy.
The copy must be ready by six.
The editor cut the copy to fit the page.

cards.def:
the department that handles incoming stories
हिंदी: समाचार डेस्क
examples: Call the news desk with the tip.
The news desk assigned a reporter.
The news desk is busiest at night.
She works on the news desk of a TV channel.

cards.def:
secret information given to a reporter
हिंदी: गुप्त सूचना
examples: A tip-off led police to the house.
The paper got a tip-off.
An anonymous tip-off helped the reporter find the story.
The customs officers acted on a tip-off.

cards.def:
a formal meeting with the press
हिंदी: पत्रकार वार्ता
examples: The CEO called a news conference.
He made the statement at a news conference.
The news conference started thirty minutes late.
The coach answered questions at a news conference.

cards.def:
an official written or spoken announcement
हिंदी: बयान
examples: The firm issued a statement.
His statement was brief.
The actor's family released a statement.
The police statement confirmed two arrests.

cards.def:
a refusal to answer
हिंदी: कोई टिप्पणी नहीं
examples: The minister said "no comment".
"No comment," she replied.
When asked about the rumours, he said no comment.
No comment can sometimes say a lot.

cards.def:
an official explanation to remove doubt
हिंदी: स्पष्टीकरण
examples: The ministry issued a clarification.
A clarification was sought.
The bank issued a clarification about the new charges.
Can I ask for a clarification on the rules?

cards.def:
the spreading of unverified talk
हिंदी: अफ़वाहों का बाज़ार
examples: The rumour mill is working overtime.
The rumour mill blamed him.
The office rumour mill says the manager is leaving.
Don't trust everything from the rumour mill.

cards.def:
information heard but not proven
हिंदी: सुनी-सुनाई बात
examples: The claim is just hearsay.
Hearsay isn't evidence.
The judge ignored the hearsay and looked at facts.
Most of what you heard is hearsay.

cards.def:
a small visible part of a large issue
हिंदी: बड़े मसले की झलक भर
examples: Experts call the leak the tip of the iceberg.
These arrests are the tip of the iceberg.
The reported cases are the tip of the iceberg.
The missing files were just the tip of the iceberg.
